{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Gets visibility state of [[:Category:Eden Editor|Eden Editor]] icons.

|s1= [[get3DENIconsVisible]] 

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Boolean]]s format [shownInMap, shownInScene]:
* shownInMap: [[Boolean]] - icons's map visibility
* shownInScene: [[Boolean]] - icons's scene visibility

|x1= <sqf>if (get3DENIconsVisible select 0) then { hint "Icons are visible on the map." };</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>get3DENIconsVisible params ["_shownInMap", "_shownInScene"];</sqf>

|seealso= [[set3DENIconsVisible]] [[set3DENLinesVisible]] [[get3DENLinesVisible]]
}}
